leftEvidence.title: Chronicles begins its genealogy with Adam

points.label: Order and honor
points.left: A compact ancestral list moves from Adam through Seth and Enosh to Noah and his sons.
points.right: A closing remembrance names Enoch, Joseph, Shem, and Seth before placing Adam above every living thing in creation.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Adam in lines of descent · later memory · 1 Chronicles 1:1–4
points.right: Adam in wisdom and reflection · later memory · Sirach 49:14–16

payload.posture: Chronicles begins with Adam; Sirach ends a sequence of praised ancestors by placing Adam above living things.

rightEvidence.title: Sirach places Adam above other remembered people

payload.tension: Adam’s place in a list changes from chronological origin to a statement of honor.
payload.title: Adam first in a genealogy and last in a remembrance
